note: Recorded from a real omp 19.1.0 rpc-ui child (isolated HOME and agent dir, a fake Anthropic server). A slow reply is streaming with one steer and one follow-up queued; then abort_and_restore_queue (Cody's Stop), plain abort (Cody's Steer now), abort_and_deliver_queue and resume (both new in 19.1.0) are tried; deliverEmpty/resumeIdle/resumeStreaming are their edge cases.
views: get_state data is a view: `model` is provider/id, `sessionFile` is a placeholder and `keys` lists every key the real payload had; the other fields are as sent. Event frames are summaries (message text cut to 70 characters); eventsBefore arrived before the command's response, eventsAfter after it.
